verified_quantities.name: DHW_ALERT_LEVEL_THRESHOLDS_C_WEEKS
verified_quantities.source: NOAA Coral Reef Watch, expanded to 5 levels Dec 2023

verified_quantities.name: GLOBAL_BLEACHING_EVENTS_REEF_AREA_AFFECTED_PCT
verified_quantities.source: NOAA/NESDIS, updated figure through September 2025 (event likely ended 2025)

verified_quantities.name: GCRMN_2025_RECOVERY_WINDOW_CURRENT_YEARS
verified_quantities.source: GCRMN & ICRI 2025, independent confirmation via cover-loss metric

tipping.derived_from: NOAA Coral Reef Watch official 5-level alert scale; level 2 (8 DHW) is where mortality risk, not just bleaching risk, begins

regen.derived_from: Hughes et al. 2018 median return interval (100 sites), independently confirmed by GCRMN & ICRI 2025's 5-6 year recovery window

formula_ref: coral-reef-utac bleaching_threshold_system.py: NOAA CRW Degree Heating Week accumulation, no ODE

honesty_checks.name: isBleachingResponseUniformAcrossGenotypes
honesty_checks.meaning: Walker et al. 2023: heat resistance varies by genotype and carries a fitness cost.

honesty_checks.name: doesHeatResistanceComeWithoutACost
honesty_checks.meaning: Walker et al. 2023: resistant genotypes show reduced growth during recovery.

honesty_checks.name: resilienceDependsOnResistanceAlone
honesty_checks.meaning: Resilience = resistance AND recovery capacity, not resistance alone.

honesty_checks.name: isAFifthGlobalBleachingEventConfirmed
honesty_checks.meaning: Guards against presenting the live WMO 2026 El Nino context as evidence of a new global bleaching event.

disclaimer: Alle Schwellenwerte und Ereignisdaten 1:1 aus coral-reef-utac. Kein UTAC/CREP/AFET, kein erfundenes Gamma.
